findings.earliest_defective_stage: conductor/line geometry extraction (MorphologyWireDetector), before ShapeDetector's ground-symbol classification is even reached for this ink

findings.summary: TerminalLocationDetector, TerminalRecognizer, ConductorBoundaryResolver, and EndpointSemanticReconstructor all confirmed to behave correctly given their (incomplete) inputs - no defect found in any of these four stages
AP-DIAG-FIX-003's ground-symbol exclusion-mask narrowing (kGroundExclusionMargin=2, src/image/shape_detector.cpp:775) confirmed still correct and not implicated in this gap
Condition is not scope-dependent and has zero effect on Wire, topology, or ElectricalNet correctness

common_root_cause.mechanism: MorphologyWireDetector's conductor-geometry extraction uses only two fixed-orientation (horizontal, vertical), fixed-minimum-length (25px kernel via MORPH_OPEN, 12px explicit minimum_segment_length filter) morphological openings; it cannot preserve diagonal ink of any length, nor axis-aligned ink shorter than the kernel
common_root_cause.manifestation_component_1: diagonal jog, invisible to both kernels regardless of length
common_root_cause.manifestation_component_2: straight vertical run shorter than the 25px kernel, fully erased by opening

control_experiment.method: standalone, uncommitted Python/OpenCV script replicating MorphologyWireDetector's exact algorithm (adaptiveThreshold block_size=31 C=7, MORPH_OPEN with 25x1 and 1x25 kernels) against the real source raster
control_experiment.conclusion: confirms causal mechanism directly - the 6b6 region's connecting ink is completely erased by vertical opening (134->0), and the 5aa region's diagonal component is invisible to both kernels

recommended_next_ap: AP-DIAG-FIX-007 - Ground Symbol Approach-Conductor Detection: a narrowly-scoped, local fix (not a global kernel/threshold change) to recover short/non-axis-aligned approach conductors in the immediate vicinity of an already-detected ChassisGround symbol's topmost bar, using the existing ground_stem_search_height presence-check corridor as a bounded search region rather than altering global MorphologyWireDetector parameters.
